transcript.text: Welcome to Onpen Shop.
In this video we will learn about how to export orders and order status.
Let's talk about key features and benefits.
Export orders is a quick way to transfer all the order details into third party analytics software or accounting software.
We can export orders either manually or all at once using this interface.
Using this section, you can easily export all your orders into your offline system.
Order status allows you to manage order via various undergoing process from the time you receive an order and till the time it gets processed and is delivered to the customer.
It keeps your customer informed about their order and also helps them tracking the orders through various stages.
Let's have a look into the admin.
First of all, click on orders, go to Export API orders.
Here you can see all the details regarding this.
So first of all, let's talk about the export DPS settings.
So this is a current setting.
As you can see over here, we click on Export API settings.
So these are the details.
As you can see over here, click on Export settings.
This will allow you to set the export style whether you want separate files per order or single file for all orders.
Next we have export file name and format.
This will allow you to set a file format which you want.
So here are some variables which you can use to set a particular export file name format.
Next we have export format.
So you can choose whether you want the export file to be in the CSE format or XML format.
Another thing we have capture order information.
So here are various information you can capture into the excel.
So these are the check boxes you can select to get the information particularly into the excel.
So whichever the check boxes you will select, only those information will be exported into your excel.
So this you will get in all your information whether it's shipping, whether it's order details or product information or customer details.
So next we have hot folder API settings.
So you can transfer all your order information into a hot folder.
So we have given this setting where you can enable the hot folder settings and you can choose the type of folder location.
If you if you have any server folder you can choose that or if you have a remote FTP folder or printer wise remote FTP or amazing cloud.
So these are the options you have and these after that you have to select order storage.
You can select common and you you have to take this mark to move job tickets to hot folder.
Enable it and you can select the folder structure out of these three options.
And then you have to click on save.
These are the API service hubs where you can where you can see the details how this get orders info works.
After doing all the settings, just go to the export API order settings, apply the filters whether you want a specific order or a less, greater than or less than equals to.
So you can just apply the order range and then put the date range over here.
We can just apply the filter for this month.
Just click on export.
So here you can see the exported file is downloaded and here you can see the data over here.
So in this way you can calculate all your export order information and you can also like transfer to the hot folder via manual transfer mode.
Next we have order status.
So let's talk about the order status and order product status.
So basically we have two types of order status and order product status.
So order status basically we manage for the whole order.
So let's suppose you have a order came up in your store and you have to manage it via order status wise or order product status wise.
So when the order comes, it will show you status as pending by default.
And in the order product status, you can see whether the order product status would be awaiting proof or proof approved.
So this you can manage via link order product status and order status through this chain as you can see over here.
So this you can manage by clicking on this edit button.
Here you can set, you can rename the title if you want in your own language or in your own.
Also, you can draft an e-mail with the subject line and e-mail messages.
Also, you can check this box to notify to your customer.
Add this to your job board or allow cancellation on this particular order status.
You can enable this button to allow your customer to download invoice at this order stage.
Similarly, we have order product status where you can edit this and you can link them with the order status over here.
So you can just select the order processing from on the list and link them with the order status over here.
Also, you can create the e-mail with subject line and e-mail message over here.
Next, you can also set this on job board and you can set whether you want to allow cancellation on this particular order product status.
So these are all order product status which you can manage.
And here there is a add button where you can add a new order status or order product status as per your requirement.
So here you have to put the title, you have to put the object line and you can put the e-mail message.
Here we have given various variables where you can just put the cursor and put the variable over here.
So you can just draft the e-mail like this.
And similarly, you can just select whether you want to notify your customer, show this as internal status or allowed cancellation on this particular order status.
So you can manage all these things and just click on save and back and your order will be saved.
So in this way, you can manage all your order status and order product status.
Thank you for watching this video.
Feel free to connect with us in case of any further concern.
Thank you.
Have a great day.
